verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships with OpenCode and Claude Code as default agent harnesses. It invites you to set up a default agent on first boot and lets you click a crash notification to send the agent to diagnose the crash. It also bundles skills so the agent can build apps, plugins and themes, and exposes the omarchy CLI so agents can handle customization and configuration. Delegating tasks to a pre-integrated assistant is therefore clearly documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent integrations, a first-party native assistant rather than third-party harnesses requiring sign-in.
